idea-plugin.name: AgentMeter
idea-plugin.description:
Monitor AI usage and quotas in Rider with AgentMeter. Keep OpenAI Codex, JetBrains AI, GitHub Copilot, Claude and Cursor balances in one Tool Window and the status bar.

Your AI quota at a glance

  • OpenAI Codex: remaining 5-hour and weekly quota, reset times and countdowns.
  • JetBrains AI: remaining subscription credits, top-up balances and plan details.
  • GitHub Copilot: consumed quota through the installed IDE plugin or ACP language server.
  • Claude: reported subscription quotas and monthly local tokens, or API connection status when subscription quotas do not apply.
  • Cursor: reported account consumption through its existing ACP sign-in.

Choose what you see

Click a subscription badge to show or hide provider details and local usage charts. Select providers and refresh intervals in configuration. Missing agent packages are identified there and hidden from Usage and the status bar. New installations enable only JetBrains AI.

Optional Weekly and Games checkboxes enable local weekly insights, quota forecasts, a boss battle with visible provider hits, and Tic-Tac-Toe with saved scores. Both are disabled by default.

Usage preview

Illustrated preview with example balances, not a live account screenshot. Available data depends on the installed provider, login method and subscription plan.

Requirements and privacy

Rider 2026.1 or later. The current Codex CLI integration requires Windows and an installed, signed-in Codex CLI. Optional providers require their loaded IDE plugin or installed ACP package and a supported local sign-in. This plugin monitors usage; it does not install or authenticate agents.

Quota requests use existing local provider sign-ins and go only to the corresponding provider. Credentials are never stored in plugin settings or usage history. No telemetry. Provider integrations use internal APIs and local formats that can change.

Maintained by Lars Nörber. Independent plugin; not affiliated with or endorsed by the named providers.
